verdict.summary: The GraphQL retry carve-out is narrow, fail-closed, and consistently applied at the existing read-scope decision point. The argv policy requires the exact `api graphql` position, exactly one parseable `query=` field, no input body, and no explicit method; all ambiguous shapes remain single-attempt. The document policy strips literals/comments before scanning, rejects mutation/subscription tokens, validates balanced delimiters and every top-level definition start, and requires an actual query operation. The accompanying tests exercise admission and refusal at document, argv, retry-loop, and shell-entrypoint layers, including the pre-existing multiline attached-field fail-open. I found no diff-supported correctness, security, or non-vacuity issue requiring changes.
